definitionZh: AI界面中实现交互式提示建议的组件。 PromptSuggestion 组件提供两种不同的模式：正常模式和突出显示模式。
sourceDefinition: A component for implementing interactive prompt suggestions in AI interfaces. The PromptSuggestion component offers two distinct modes: Normal Mode and Highlight Mode.
